Container.Name: wlt-update
Container.Overview: Update server for the WLANThermo Nano V3 gas fork: offers the fork releases to the device, forwards all other requests unchanged to api.wlanthermo.de and records telemetry/cloud data as cook sessions. Needs a fixed IP in br0 (port 80). Reachable only from the home network.
Container.Requires: Fixed IP in br0 outside the DHCP range of the FritzBox. The --dns entries make sure the real api.wlanthermo.de is resolved via public DNS, never via wlt-dns.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Firmware cache and SQLite database (cook sessions)

Config.Name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
Config.Description: http:// plus the fixed IP of this container (must match the IP above)

Config.Name: ALLOWED_NETS
Config.Description: Only these networks may use telemetry, sessions and admin

Config.Name: GITHUB_REPO
Config.Description: Repository with the gas fork releases

Config.Name: GITHUB_TOKEN
Config.Description: Only if the fork is private: fine-grained token, read only, only this repository (Contents: Read-only). Leave empty for a public fork.

Config.Name: POLL_INTERVAL_S
Config.Description: How often new releases are fetched (seconds)

Config.Name: ROLLBACK_TAGS
Config.Description: Official firmware kept for a rollback (never offered automatically)

Config.Name: UPSTREAM_DNS
Config.Description: Public resolvers for the real api.wlanthermo.de (never the FritzBox)

Config.Name: SESSION_GAP_S
Config.Description: A pause longer than this starts a new cook session (seconds)
